profile.headline: User-Centered Software Developer
profile.summary:
I have enjoyed every facet of technology that I have worked on, even those outside of software, but being a software developer stimulates both my creative and logical functions.  I find that I can effectively inject my outside experiences into my software builds to make them even more user-friendly, scalable, efficient, and powerful.

I have a passion for the user experience, team culture, and continuous improvement and hold myself to uncommonly high standards in these areas.  My interest in rapid application development has me delving deeper into the various JavaScript frameworks, libraries, and stacks that have gotten so much traction in the past several years.  

Outside of the office, I enjoy high intensity exercise, cooking or baking, playing bass guitar, and travelling.  I dabble a bit with strategy or roleplaying games and have taken to trying my hand at creating one of my own.  My house has also seen a lot of my (and my wife's) creativity and desire to build useful and attractive projects, and we've thoroughly enjoyed improving and customizing our space.

I have additional work experience that is not shown on my LinkedIn profile as it was internships or not software development related.  Ask for a copy of my resume to see the full gamut of my work history.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
· Owned and improved multiple end-to-end customer workflows for creating and modifying cloud assets, increasing usability and operational efficiency

· Led early-stage investigation of production incidents, tracing complex cross-system issues and isolating root causes across frontend rendering, API behavior, and configuration layers

· Improved application performance by parallelizing network calls, reducing user-facing load times

· Built new and refactored existing features with a reusable component focus, creating patterns that accelerated feature delivery team-wide

· Collaborated closely with UX Designer and customer liaison to ensure features were user-focused, practical, and improved upon existing solutions

· Kept a continuous eye on code structure and patterns, refactoring toward cleaner, more maintainable implementation using principles like DRY and KISS

· Brought full-stack and IT perspective to a frontend role, addressing cross-functional gaps in RESTful API architecture, timely data delivery, and code cleanliness

positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cross-platform Development · Lean UX · Single Page Applications · Git · Full-Stack Development · React.js · NoSQL · JavaScript

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Developed user-facing, enterprise-scale applications in Vue JS and Java Spring Boot.  Deployed products to Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) manually and via Jenkins.  Ensured code quality through peer reviews and strict adherence to correct, meaningful unit and integration testing.  ​

Provided the business with data dashboards and APIs to allow visibility to uptime and troubleshooting information to achieve high levels of service to clients.​

Accepted leadership responsibility in front-end development on teams with heavy back-end experience.  Broke down knowledge siloes through targeted pair programming.​

Upgraded Virtual Machines on Microsoft Azure and seized lead role in completing team tasks for migration to Google Cloud Platform (GCP).  Performed DevOps team tasks including creation of Jenkins pipelines, managing Jenkins build nodes, configuration of Kubernetes through Redhat OpenShift, spinning up new PCF instance on GCP with all necessary services and security, creating uptime monitoring scripts, generating security-compliant Docker container images, and scanning existing code and artifacts for vulnerabilities.​

Further aided team dynamics by promoting a strong Agile culture by coaching on user story best practices, getting value from retrospectives, and Minimum Viable Product (MVP) focus.  Assisted project manager in running needed meetings and cancelling others.
positions.insights: Skills: Docker · Lean UX · Single Page Applications · Spring Boot · Git · Full-Stack Development · Jenkins · Vue.js · Java · Extreme Programming · JavaScript

· Owned deployment and DevOps workflows including Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes (OpenShift), and Google Cloud Platform (PCF on GCP)

· Ensured code quality through peer reviews and robust unit/integration testing practices

positions.title: Software Designer
positions.description:
· Developed web and cross-platform mobile applications for factory automation and workflow improvement

· Mentored teammates on UX design concepts, TDD (Test-Driven Development), and Extreme Programming (XP) principles

· Led all JavaScript development across two engineering teams

· Applied UX principles to eliminate low-value work, resulting in ~$250K in cost savings

· Improved application reliability from 97.7% (avg 4hrs/week down) to 99.99% uptime

positions.description: Test-driven development, pair programming, small Agile team, C# in Visual Studio, web apps and mobile apps.  Worked with Xamarin, ASP.NET MVC, Classic ASP, SQL, and a wonderful team who focused on the user's needs and delivering results.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:

· Automated software release process, reducing upgrade time by 83%

· Created freight-cost prediction algorithm 30% more accurate than existing forecasts

positions.title: Internet Sales Manager
positions.description:
· Built and managed internet sales department from the ground up, scaling monthly revenue from $1,000 to $20,000

· Maintained and upgraded server, client, and network systems supporting business operations

· Partnered with vendors to improve software workflows and reduce operational complexity

· Elected youngest-ever Chairman of the Automotive Recycler’s Association E-commerce Committee

volunteerExperiences.description: OCAAT - One Community At A Time - partners with a local charity called Water Missions International.  The volunteers build relationships with small communities in rural Honduras and teach them how to rely on each other and take ownership of their town.  Through these relationships, we have seen the communities raise tens of thousands of dollars on their own (which our donors graciously match dollar for dollar) and complete improvements to dangerous roads, parasite-riddled water sources, schools, and more.
